security_audit.summary: The skill is mostly documentation and notebook-review tooling, and most static findings are markdown code spans or safe setup examples. One real issue remains in validate_notebook.py: the detect-secrets command builds sh -c strings with unescaped notebook paths, which can allow command injection through crafted filenames.

remediation.suggestion: Replace the sh -c and xargs pipeline with a subprocess argument list that passes notebook_abs, baseline_path, and plugins_path as separate arguments. Avoid shell interpolation entirely.

content.value_statement: Cookbook notebooks can be hard to review consistently across narrative, code quality, and technical accuracy. This skill combines automated checks with a structured rubric for clear review reports.
actual_capabilities: Reads a cookbook style guide before starting each review.
Runs a notebook validation script when a notebook path is available.
Generates markdown from notebooks to reduce review noise.
Scores narrative quality, code quality, technical accuracy, and actionability.
Reports strengths, critical issues, and prioritized recommendations.
Checks for common notebook issues such as noisy outputs and hardcoded secrets.
limitations: Designed for Anthropic Cookbook notebooks, not general documentation audits.
Requires a local notebook file path for automated validation.
Automated checks do not replace manual judgment about pedagogy and accuracy.
The validator depends on local tools such as uv, nbconvert, and detect-secrets.

use_cases.title: Review a New Cookbook Submission
use_cases.description: Evaluate a draft notebook against the Cookbook rubric before publication.

use_cases.title: Improve Notebook Teaching Quality
use_cases.description: Find weak introductions, missing explanations, and unclear learning objectives.

use_cases.title: Catch Technical Notebook Issues
use_cases.description: Run validation checks for secrets, model names, output noise, and structure problems.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Notebook Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: You have one notebook and want a full review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Cookbook notebook: <path-to-notebook>. Use the standard rubric and give me the overall score, key strengths, critical issues, and specific recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Focused Narrative Review
prompt_templates.scenario: You want feedback on teaching flow and learning objectives.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review <path-to-notebook> for narrative quality only. Focus on the introduction, learning objectives, section flow, and conclusion.

prompt_templates.title: Technical Readiness Check
prompt_templates.scenario: You want to catch publication blockers before manual review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the automated checks for <path-to-notebook>, then summarize any critical issues, warnings, and likely publication blockers.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Publication Review
prompt_templates.scenario: You need a detailed final audit with examples and rewrite guidance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Perform a publication-ready audit of <path-to-notebook>. Include scoring for all four dimensions, cite specific sections, and propose concrete rewrites for the most important issues.

output_examples.input: Audit a notebook about building a CI triage agent.
output_examples.output: Executive summary with an overall score, strengths, critical issues, dimension scores, and prioritized edits for introduction, setup, code explanations, and conclusion.

output_examples.input: Check whether a notebook is ready for publication.
Review only the introduction and conclusion.
output_examples.output: Targeted feedback on problem framing, learning objectives, recap quality, and next-step guidance.

best_practices: Provide the notebook path in the first request so automated checks can run.
Ask for a focused review when you only need feedback on one dimension.
Use the recommendations as an edit checklist before requesting another audit.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill as the only security review for production code.
Do not ignore manual review because automated checks passed.
Do not ask it to audit unrelated documents without adapting the rubric first.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews Anthropic Cookbook notebooks for narrative quality, code quality, technical accuracy, and actionability.

faq.question: Does it run automated checks?
faq.answer: Yes. When a notebook path is provided, it uses validate_notebook.py to run structural and technical checks.

faq.question: Can it detect hardcoded secrets?
faq.answer: The validator attempts to run detect-secrets and also includes fallback pattern checks for common key formats.

faq.question: Does it edit the notebook automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill produces an audit report and recommendations unless the user separately asks for edits.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It is compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code according to the report metadata.

faq.question: Is it suitable for non-Cookbook notebooks?
faq.answer: It can provide useful feedback, but the rubric is tailored to Anthropic Cookbook standards.
